l-m-m1-b05-10.s.s1.r.d: Kunyangwe a iri negative, x=b/a ndiyo solution.
l-m-m1-b05-10.s.s1.explain: Kana a=0, ipapo 0·x=b. Kana b≠0, hapana x inoshanda, saka hapana solution.
l-m-m1-b05-10.s.s2.model.0: Kana a=0, divi rekuruboshwe rinogara riri 0, saka hapana solution kana b isiri 0 chete.
l-m-m1-b05-10.s.s2.model.1: Kana a=0 uye b=0, x yose ndiyo solution, saka unofanira kutarisa b≠0 zvakare.

l-m-m1-b05-22.s.s2.model.1: Chibereko che x ne y nguva dzose ndi 20, saka kana x ichiva nguva 2 huru, y inova hafu.
